title: Japanese-Style Takikomi Gohan
description: A flavorful Japanese dish featuring a mixture of rice, vegetables, and chicken cooked together in a savory broth.
instructions: Rinse the rice and soak it in water for 30 minutes.
Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and season with salt and pepper.
Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat and cook the chicken until browned.
Add the mixed mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the jeweled onions and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the Japanese rice to the pan and stir to combine with the other ingredients.
Add the lemon juice, soy sauce, and gohan (if using) to the pan and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and cover the pan.
Simmer the mixture for 15-20 minutes, or until the rice is cooked and the liquid has been absorbed.
Fluff the rice mixture with a fork and serve hot.
